title: ProTint Photochromic Replacement Shield
features: Photochromic technology adjusts tint automatically based on sunlight intensity
Universal fit designed for most standard motorcycle helmets
Durable polycarbonate construction resists scratches and UV damage
description:
Engineered to withstand harsh ultraviolet radiation and dense condensation, the ProTint Photochromic Replacement Shield from Universal Moto elevates visual clarity across demanding weather conditions. Built with Hydrophobic Rain-Shedding Exterior Coating with Perimeter Airtight Seal, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Toolless quick-release pivot lever swap in 10 seconds).

The ProTint Photochromic Replacement Shield is an essential visual clarity upgrade from Universal Moto. By delivering edge-to-edge optical fidelity and bulletproof fog prevention, it dramatically improves situational awareness across unpredictable climates.
